footprint_reference: placeholder XP cube /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube (100 cm) x scale 0.3 = 30 cm (BP_PickupXP, bp-pickup-xp); hex 30 cm across corners (X), 25.98 across flats (Y)
warnings: glow emissive is not carried by the FBX: the Unreal material must set the emissive colour (0, 0.9, 1) on M_XPNut_glow

fidelity.slope_angle_note: estimated from the source ring between the flat top and the hole, about 40 degrees from horizontal (not 45); uncertain by about 5 degrees because the ring is seen at 52 degrees elevation

C1.evidence: Hexagonal prism 30 x 25.98 x 11.7 cm, height 45 % of across-flats; still differs: the source looks slightly taller from its higher camera.

C2.evidence: Flat top, one sloped ring (40 deg estimate, 1.9 cm deep), one flat 12-gon disc parallel to the top, no wall, steps, bands or ring; rim 62 %, disc 44.7 % of across-flats. Still differs: the source hole is deeper with stepped walls, removed by owner decision.

C3.evidence: 6 corner bevels visible as facets on the top face and the 12 slope facets below; still differs: bevels are subtler than the source.

C4.evidence: Exactly two materials: M_XPNut_body (grey, body and slope ring) and M_XPNut_glow (cyan 0, 0.9, 1).

C5.evidence: tris_out 80 (budget 300); 30 cm across corners; pivot bottom centre.

C6.evidence: Flat shading, large facets, no texture.

C7.evidence: Cyan only on the flat centre disc, no blue band anywhere. Still differs: no bloom in Blender (Unreal adds it); preview disc looks flat saturated cyan.
